name: spring-calendar
title: Spring Calendar
blurb: Animated event calendar with spring transitions and morphing text.
description: A calendar that shows events for selected days with spring physics animation. Clicking a date button shows that day's events with smooth layout transitions. TextMorph animates the day display. Height adjusts based on event count.
use_when: A vibrant event calendar for dashboards or scheduling apps where animation adds polish.
avoid_when: When prefers-reduced-motion is a priority — all transitions are motion-based.
a11y: Buttons are clickable and keyboard-accessible. Event text is semantically rendered. No aria labels for animation.
